question: Can a fixed simple temperature-increment statistical model improve the next published5min room-temperature label over BOTH temperature persistence and last-increment continuation in two new measured experimental rooms?
object: Same dual-zone test bed,8days of Aug2025,2rooms with per-room reported smart-meter power and measured indoor temperatures. Not field comfort/dispatch/independent-site generalisation.
paper_basis: Crossref10.1016/j.enbuild.2026.118112 registers a measured-data RC-network study; SSRN10.2139/ssrn.6828065 abstract supports mechanism direction. Full methods/parameters unavailable, abstract fetch403. This is OUR simplified heat-balance/temperature-increment statistical baseline, NOT full-paper parameter/results or MPC reproduction.
inputs: current same-room electric power W divided by1000
information_time: Conditional offline prediction assuming ALL CURRENT PUBLISHED ROW inputs available at its label. Power averaging interval/publication delay/control time not established, hence not verified online lead time. Never use next-row power/weather/other-room temperature, commands, future schedules or future differences as inputs.
solar: Excluded: released labelMJ/m2 is an energy-per-area quantity with unspecified accumulation period, not instantaneous irradiance. Do not convert or infer future radiation.
sample: All8files*allrows*2rooms are candidates in ORIGINAL file order, no inter-file windows. Require previous/current/next original rows and both adjacent time gaps exactly300s, parseable naive source minute clock; all5inputs and next own-room target finite, all involved temperatures in broad0..60C QC. No threshold on target change,power sign,error or control/on/off state. Preserve every exclusion reason; no filling,sorting,smoothing,clipping or combining across dates. First/last per-file rows cannot form3point window.

split.method: Fixed first4complete chronological days train, later4complete days test. Same2rooms, new time periods; no random row split, no crossing missing dates, no selection after errors.

models.fit: Separate5coefficients/room,total10,OLSnumpy.linalg.lstsq rcond1e-12,each whole training file equal total weight. No hyperparameter search/regularisation/physical constraints/clipping/route selection. Coefficients statistical, not separately identified R,C,COP or causal power-to-temperature effects.

gate: M_HEAT5 MAE and RMSE strictly below BOTH B_P and B_TREND for pooled test,each of2rooms,and pooled CURRENT source-P>0 subgroup; additionally at least2of4complete test days improve both metrics over BOTH baselines. No new formal90% target, no point accuracy=1-MAE conversion. All daily/room/on-positive/off-zero groups and worst values reported even on failure.
support: Report training ranks/coefficients and input range; out-of-domain test inputs retained/flagged; no excluding a room/period by fit rank or score.
preserve: D059/D060/D061 protocol,models,predictions and failures unchanged; this new dataset was not used for their model selection. New holdout inspected for provenance/QA only, no new fitting/forecast errors before this freeze.
not_verified: online availability and true lead time
actual comfortable allowable capacity or authorisation
other devices/sites/seasons or statistical independence of adjacent labels
